svg.title: Lotus Tower Stage 1 road-data audit preview
svg.desc: Static overview of audited OpenStreetMap roads, mapped features and candidate delivery stops. This is not gameplay.
svg.text: Stage 1 offline preview · source snapshot 2026-09-10T23:11:10Z · not a playable map
Dr. Colvin R. de Silva Mawatha (Union Place)
Ven. Baddegama Wimalawansa Thero Mawatha (Dean's Road)

g.text: Core: 700 OSM highway ways · 23 signals · 146 crossings · 4 roundabout ways + 1 mini-roundabout nodes · 22 bridge-tagged ways
Context circle: 1688 highway ways (988 context-only) · 15 undirected components · 15 unverified stop candidates
Candidates require field verification. Zero mapped features means none were found in this snapshot; it does not confirm real-world absence.
